newsitem.title: JAPAN: TEPCO Fukushima reactor leaks radioactive coolant.
newsitem.headline: TEPCO Fukushima reactor leaks radioactive coolant.

text.p: Tokyo Electric Power Co Inc (TEPCO) said on Monday its 784,000-kilowatt (kw) reactor at the Fukushima No.1 nuclear power plant, north of Tokyo, leaked a small amount of radioactive coolant on Sunday.
The leak was found at one of the two back-up pumps at the reactor which send coolant back to the reactor pressure vessel, a TEPCO spokesman said.
The electric utility lowered operating rates at the reactor by about 30 percent to 550,000 kw following the accident as a precaution, while investigating the cause of the leak.
The spokesman said it was not clear when the company could bring the unit back to normal operational levels.
The leak had no impact on the environment, he added.
